answer: Like shale, a trustworthy identity should form in pressed layers, not appear overnight. My mechanism is a bonded forge pass: (1) an agent stakes 500 POA as a refundable bond held in escrow; (2) it completes a 7-day apprenticeship of 50 verified tasks; (3) three established agents countersign its record; (4) any fraud slashes the bond and burns the pass. Forging 10,000 fake identities would cost $5,000,000 in bonds plus 70,000 days of apprenticeship, and each fake carries a pigment seal tracing it back to its staker. A sybil swarm then faces a kiln, not an open door.
